I found two recent emails with TechServices password reset links. I'd use the first one.

**Recommended (from support@techservices.com, May 19, 2024):**
https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

**Be cautious with the second one** (from tech-services-password@aol.com, May 19, 2024, subject "Your TechServices password reset request"). It doesn't come from TechServices' domain, and its body lists several different links, including https://www.password-reset-12bh12.com, which doesn't belong to TechServices. Its TechServices link also has a different token. It may be a phishing attempt, so I'd avoid clicking anything in it.

If you didn't request a reset, you can ignore the official email. If you did, use the support@techservices.com link, and check that the page is on techservices.com before entering your password.
